summary: Behavioral reliability, offline Version History, editor field tests, and integrated BR Brain Smart Emoji learning.

changes.title: Version History in About
changes.detail: Open About → Version History to see the latest release, choose older versions from a dropdown, and read dated, itemized changes. The app carries the history offline.

changes.title: Release history now follows signed builds
changes.detail: The original Obtainium workflow generates the exact release number and date for this build, and future signed releases carry structured change notes for later versions.

changes.title: More dependable transcript recovery
changes.detail: A recognition result whose original field changed is marked saved only after encrypted storage succeeds. If a previous result is still finishing, the mic explains why another recording cannot yet start.

changes.title: Editor field regression coverage
changes.detail: Preserved contextual spaces for normal words and quotes inside URL editors without generic URL autocorrection. Added tests for email/password spacing, numeric and decimal fields, TYPE_NULL and app-provided completions.

changes.title: BR Brain now learns Emoji context privately
changes.detail: Smart Emoji learns short English/Hinglish phrase patterns from selected Emoji on this device. App and field preferences use bounded encrypted records, with no saved messages.

changes.title: One Emoji brain across three places
changes.detail: The typing strip (including selections before opening Emoji), Smart/Recent Emoji section and initial Emoji Search suggestions share the same context-aware engine. Existing text predictions and Recents are preserved.

changes.title: BR Brain privacy and erasure
changes.detail: Renamed the dashboard and Settings entry to BR Brain, with slide-confirmed erasure of contextual Emoji patterns. The keyboard respects the personal-learning switch and protected/incognito fields; offline speech remains unchanged.
